[spoiler=[b]- Maasis Worsening conditions -[/b]]
Maasis eyes open to the white tiled ceiling. This must have been the forth time he has blacked out today. For the past 3 days Astanirs most esteemed general has been trapped in this rather undignified hospital, unable to rule his grand nation. It wouldve frustrated him, but he is to tired for frustration, he cant even keep his eyes open for longer than an hour. His brain has been thumping against the inside of his skull over and over and over to the point of driving him insane, in conjunction with the intense pain in his lungs.

*cough* *COUGH* [b]*COUGH*[/b]

The tip tap of heels on a concrete floor are heard, coming closer. The nurse has come to check on Maasi, just as he begins to slip back into his painful sleep. The 20-year outdated medical equipment beside his bed begins to beep slower as he slips away again, despite the pain
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]- Testing -[/b]]
Kaleo is a young Astaniran, 32 years of age. For years he had silently, carefully advocated for change, for Astanir to break out of its isolationism. When this finally came true, first with the joining of the IA and then with the relaxation of border control, he took the opportunity instantly. He travelled to places he had dreamed of since his childhood. Hydronia - the former colonial master of Astanir, Chimor - the land of ancient relics, Pantagruel - the massive giant that dominates Erenes maps, but most prominently of all, Llyndorra - the social, cultural and historical powerhouse of the planet. His visit had been an amazing experience, but what Kaleo didnt realise is that he had inadvertently brung the Llyndorran flu, a deadly disease that now ravages the planet, back to Astanir. He now lies in a hospital bed, alongside thousands others that have been unfortunate enough to share his fate.

Kaleo wakes up as a jolt of pain surges through his body. He feels multiple needles stuck into various parts of his body. A huge wail of pain is let out as nurses inject him with various experimental substances, a supposed test cure. As the unknown substances flow through his body, he begins to drift away. The heart monitor beside his bed slowly grinds to a stop as Kaleos body lies limp in the bed sheets. The nurses prepare a new set of substances and move onto the next patient.
[/spoiler]

The Platypus 1B have become the most used vehicle for patrols and movement of military and medical personell as it have proved to be the easiest military APC to make fully sealed as it was allready made to be amphibius, making it common to see it driving around in the Ostland and Aboria regions.

Meanwhile the Llyndora tourists, who originaly made up the majorety of the early deaths from the virus, are among the first groups of people to show signs of recovering from the virus, the Nordiheim foreign office have started talks with the Llyndora goverment for how to send them home for when they hopefully recover.
